headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Do not center-align. Break the typical SaaS look.
headings.installation: Add via Fontsource or Google Fonts for Chivo/Cabinet Grotesk.

mono.usage: For task IDs, agent statuses, code blocks, metrics, and terminal-like modals.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-black/60 and 1px inner border-white/10 for any panel overlapping the 3D canvas (like sidebars and chat overlays). DO NOT use purely transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use subtle drop-shadows with the accent_ai color when an AI is actively working on a task.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle noise grain overlay over the entire application to reduce the synthetic digital feel.

grids_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-4, gap-4). Every pixel utilized. Sharp corners, dense.
grids_layouts.agent_profile: Bento Grid (grid-cols-12, gap-8). Hero span-8 (3D Avatar viewer), secondary stats span-4.
grids_layouts.office_hero: Absolute positioning. 3D canvas takes 100% of viewport (w-full h-screen). UI components float over the canvas using z-10, absolute/fixed layout with glassmorphism.

components.buttons: Sharp rectangular, flat background, 1px border. On hover: bg changes, text color ensures contrast. No heavy shadows.
components.cards: Cardless or 1px subtle border. Rely on border color for definition, dense spacing.
components.modals: Human-in-the-loop approval modals should look like command terminals. Dark background, monospace headers, clear Approve/Reject buttons.
components.kanban: Linear-style minimalist lanes. No heavy backgrounds. Just a subtle line separator and dense, compact cards.

motion.general: Fast, precise, no bouncing. transition-transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.
motion.3d_envelope: Signature flying envelope: Use Bezier curves in 3D space to fly from sender desk to receiver desk. Emits a soft glow in sender's accent color (AI=Mint, Human=Orange).

3d_libraries.guidelines: Lighting is CRITICAL. Use <Environment preset='city' /> or soft rectAreaLights. Do not rely solely on ambient light. Avatars can be simplified low-poly figures to match a 'Simulacra' stylized vibe rather than hyper-realistic.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React using Javascript (NOT Typescript). Write code in .js and .jsx files.
The 3D Virtual Office is the Hero screen. Use React Three Fiber to build an isometric grid room.
Do NOT make the UI look like a basic generic dashboard. Use glassmorphism overlays on top of the 3D canvas.
Implement the Kanban board using a very dense, text-first approach similar to Linear.
Create the 'Flying Envelope' using framer-motion-3d or R3F's useFrame to interpolate between 3D vectors when an event triggers.
Include a Human-in-the-loop modal that dims the 3D view and focuses sharply on the task details.
Never use empty placeholder texts for logos or missing data. Rely on the provided image urls.
Always add data-testid attributes to all interactive and key informational elements.
universal_guidelines: No generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlapping panels.
Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties (transition-transform, transition-opacity).
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on UI elements floating over content. Always use glass or solid fill.
Use Phosphor icons or lucide-react for sharp, consistent tech icons.
Add test IDs (data-testid) to all interactive elements. Example: data-testid='approve-task-button'
